description: Defines the NetworkErrorLoggingService class and related data structures for handling network error logging, policies, and reports in Chromium project.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService
classes.description: Abstract class for managing network error logging policies, reports, and storage.

classes.name: PersistentNelStore
classes.description: Interface for persistent storage of NEL policies.

classes.name: NelPolicyKey
classes.description: Represents a unique key for a NEL policy based on (NIK, origin).

classes.name: WildcardNelPolicyKey
classes.description: Represents a wildcard NEL policy key for a domain and its subdomains.

classes.name: NelPolicy
classes.description: Contains details of a NEL policy, including expiration, report endpoint, and fractions.

classes.name: RequestDetails
classes.description: Details of a network error request for reporting.

classes.name: SignedExchangeReportDetails
classes.description: Details of a signed exchange report.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a NetworkErrorLoggingService instance with optional persistent store.

methods.name: OnHeader
methods.description: Ingests a NEL header for a given (NIK, origin) and IP address.

methods.name: OnRequest
methods.description: Queues a network error report based on request details.

methods.name: RemoveBrowsingData
methods.description: Removes origin policies matching a filter.

methods.name: SetReportingService
methods.description: Sets the reporting service used for queuing reports.

methods.name: SetClockForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom clock for testing purposes.

methods.name: StatusAsValue
methods.description: Returns a Value representing current policies for debugging.

methods.name: GetPolicyKeysForTesting
methods.description: Returns current policy keys for testing.

methods.name: GetPersistentNelStoreForTesting
methods.description: Returns the persistent store instance for testing.

methods.name: GetReportingServiceForTesting
methods.description: Returns the reporting service for testing.
